notes.title: 🥳 M.O.O.D.S. Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/cb4b69f295f784b928505ae4c9f51c082908142e.png

🥳 M.O.O.D.S. will be released on Steam Early Access on July 29th!🥳 

M.O.O.D.S., aka Mechanical Organisms on Destructive Substances. It is a top-down roguelike twin-stick shooter where you fight crazed robots with futuristic guns equipped with switchable addin modifications. A long time ago, humans left the Earth, and to become more like their creators, mechs implanted themselves with an Emotion Module to feel the moods people had experienced. It did not go well.

Four Years of Development in One Image
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/d3ebd7c2d71fc92c6ac28544e0342b19a98abf14.gif

Main Gameplay: [olist]
 The main innovative part of the gameplay is short talks with Bosses before the battle. In games like Hades or Tiny Rogue boss dialogue is an essential part of world-building. But in M.O.O.D.S., the emotion you choose to answer with will affect how your next boss battle will go. Valery will be weakened by a sad or lovable answer, but she will add cryo to her bullets if your answer is fired with anger.
 Addins modifications are another curious addition. You can switch them at any time between the two weapons you carry. Some addins work better with one type of weapons, others will add some interesting effects in general, and some… are here just to bring chaos. For example, Acid Puddle Addin that leaves said puddles while bullets fly works best with fast-shooting weapons with many bullets in the magazine, like a Swarm Emitter or Arcblaster. But it is useless with sniper-type weapons. Psst! Never try Glitcher Addin —you have been warned.
 Classes are presented with 5 Emotions: Joy that summons an auto-shooting turret, Pride that covers itself with a reflective shield, Love that charms enemies to fight on your side, Anger that increases your fire rate, and Sorrow with its taunting mech-dog. More curious are the upgrades for the class abilities. Like Anger’s upgrade to prolong ability effect time with each kill, making it an OP skill for otherwise challenging rooms.
 M.O.O.D.S. is more than a roguelike survivor-like game. Aside from dungeon-crawler-like maps filled with enemies to shoot, you will find NPCs with quests, secret and challenge rooms, or enemies that run away and drop more cash when killed. There are elements of base-building, where you start in a lame flying junkyard and then build workshops for your NPC friends. Also, there is a shared-screen local co-op to play with friends on Steam or when someone crashes at your place.
[/olist]

Brand New Trailer
[previewyoutube=jMIINegXVb8;full][/previewyoutube]

The Content Roadmap is coming soon!

-StickyStone Studio

notes.title: Recent Updates - Accessibility, New Content, Upcoming Beta
notes.content:
Hello! It is StickyStone Studios.
We want to share bits of what we were working on after the Prologue release!

Accessibility - Bullet Colors
One of the feedback we have received a lot was unconventional projectile colors. Some even said that the bullet colors of char and enemies were swapped, making it difficult to get used to the game at first.
During our deep dive into the topic, we found out that there are 300 million color-blind people in the world, with every 1 out of 12 men having it to a certain extent.

Johnny - I told you guys, it is magenta! Not pink!

98% of color blindness is in red-green zone, meaning 1/12 players could not play Anger char in the Pride Region. So we fixed this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/8a39a78051114bae014aa5014b0290e1e93e2f3e.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/fd51847e8bedb289d695cb156de0e40229befd04.gif

Not only char colors! You can pick the enemy bullet color too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/8056bfab504501eab40c9656471a4c273537ae99.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/0e7ce3066b6b021b73d1e05c3d4dcdb42f2df49e.gif

New Content - New Region & Char
Now there are 3 regions — Pride, Anger, and Sorrow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/434848b1c716f0303e25412832e1df5898256f43.png
For the Sorrow region, The Silent Ruins, we have chosen an urban design. As the main topic of the lore is about humans leaving robots behind, this whole region is about the reminiscence of the once most populated places mech's creators used to live in.

Currently, we are working on making environments more visually readable and harmonic. As well as filling it with more content.

More unique enemies
Mechs in the Sorrow Region are more technologically advanced and are much more disciplined, making them more fierce than any foe you have met before.

Chargers - shine red before ramming you
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/3aed16ff9a0b8720dab51a51f4f35da58fa0ce3d.png

Upcoming Beta - The list is almost decided
If you consider joining, submit your request here. If someone decides not to participate, we will call you : )
https://forms.gle/6HjBZn3fWpva4JdT7

Join our Discord

You'll be able to discover M.O.O.D.S. all over again, as we have added a plethora of things to explore since last Demo. There is also LOCAL MULTIPLAYER now, so you can enjoy the game at home with your friends!

Other new things:
- A bunch of new Weapon Addins!
- A huge amount of new Equipment Abilities
- New classes
- A new boss
- A new Tutorial level
- A brand-new home base with new NPCs
- MoodsME AI-powered emotional webcam scanner
- Plenty of gameplay improvements & bugfixes

If you want to pay us a visit in person, come on down to
Hall 10.2, Booth E-010g-D-021g at #IAHoI

We hope to see you at Gamescom and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: M.O.O.D.S. Demo Release
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315850/965eb71bccd24ae3151801544cb2629f40663f0b.pngWelcome to the World of M.O.O.D.S. 
where Machines were abandoned by their human masters and now fight for the power of emotions!

We are proud to announce our participation in the Going Rogue Event on Steam with our latest Demo Version of M.O.O.D.S.! During the entire Event, you will be able to download and play our game for free.

There is a scrapload of content already available within the game: 
- Two different classes (you have to work a little to try the second one)
- Venture into Mitron's Kingdom and descend up to six floors deep 
- Face three different Mech Bosses in order to beat this demo
- Six different Weapons enable different ways of disassembling hostile Mechs
- Over a million Weapon modification combinations, we did the math

If you do decide to check out M.O.O.D.S., it would be very helpful if you take a minute to fill out our 
 Survey  and provide some feedback we can use to further improve the game, every opinion counts!

To keep up with the newest developments and future demos and releases, make sure to join our  Discord Server and Social Media Accounts
